name: Deep return to a target zone
summary: Partner serves cooperatively; the receiver returns past a cone line deep in the server's half and moves in to the non-volley-zone line.
setup: Cones in a line about 2 m inside the server's baseline
Partner serves at an easy pace into the receiver's service box; serve as your rules allow, the serve rules are UNVERIFIED in this app
Receiver lets the serve bounce, returns deep past the cones, then walks in to the non-volley-zone line; no rally after the return
Sets of 10 returns, then swap roles
success_criterion: In a set of 10 returns: at least 7 land in and past the cone line and at most 1 misses
coach_rationale: (judgment) A deep return keeps the server back and buys the receiver time to reach the line, the usual base for winning a receiving rally (AN-02); cooperative serves and no live rally keep it beginner level. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
